Added and committed the attestation requirement: `d58f50f5 docs(spec): require attested durable release assets`.

The new contract requires binary uploads to have:

- exact intent/source/byte-digest matches;
- a verified GitHub artifact attestation;
- the expected repository, immutable signer workflow, and source commit.

Local v1 execution remains source-only; unattested binaries are rejected. The implementation plan now includes tests for wrong repository/workflow/source attestations and workflow permissions. GitHub supports this verification model through `gh attestation verify`. [GitHub docs](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/secure-your-work/use-artifact-attestations/use-artifact-attestations)

The model/graph prototype edits remain uncommitted on purpose, pending the plan’s first cleanup and characterization-test gate.
I’m tracing the current release prototypes against the split specs and the already-landed Git trust code, focusing on concrete blockers before implementation continues.
